art.subject: Swinhoe's Minivet (Pericrocotus cantonensis), adult male: forehead and forecrown white, the white reaching back to just over the eye; lores and a stripe through the eye black; rear crown, nape, mantle and back brownish-grey; rump and uppertail coverts paler buffy-brown; wings blackish with a pale buffy-white patch at the base of the flight feathers visible on the folded wing; underparts whitish, with a buff-grey wash on the breast sides and flanks; tail long, black in the centre with white outer feathers. Bill and legs black.
art.pose: perched upright on an outer twig in a treetop, side view
art.scene: Canopy of a broadleaf tree on a Korean offshore island in May, during spring migration, clear light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched upright on a treetop twig, wingtips lowered to show the rump: slim, long-tailed minivet, white forehead extending behind the eye, broad black eye-stripe from the bill base, grey hindcrown, nape and mantle with no black, brownish lower back and rump, whitish underparts washed dingy brown on the breast and flanks

adult female, side view perched upright in a treetop: like the male but drabber, pale grey upperparts tinged brown, less white on the forehead, the pale supercilium behind the eye reduced or absent, dull brownish rump, underparts washed very pale buff, long tail
art.build: Slim, long-tailed songbird, about the size of Ashy Minivet: a little larger than a sparrow in body but with a much longer tail; small, flat-topped head and upright posture in treetops. Bill short, black, slightly hooked. Legs short, black. Tail long and graduated. In flight a pale bar runs across the flight feathers. Moves restlessly through the canopy in small flocks. Females are duller, with a greyer, less white forehead.
avoid: Do not paint a black crown and nape, a pure grey back and rump and clean white underparts; those mark Ashy Minivet (Pericrocotus divaricatus).
Do not paint any red, orange or yellow; this is a grey, brown and white minivet.
Do not paint a grey rump; it is brownish.
